Classroom source: HEIG-VD, Geomatics group (2026), Photogrammetry and LiDAR datasets.
https://huggingface.co/datasets/heig-vd-geo/scop-datasets
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

MemorX used 70 selected source photographs. Reconstruction and selected-view
refinement by MemorX. Includes inferred appearance. Estimated scale, not for
measurement. The website deck displays the actual local MVP Gaussian-splat
scene, with the same aligned camera frame and Brush-classic photographic filter.

Original classroom photograph is unchanged from the source capture.
Three.js v0.187.0 and Spark v2.4.0 are bundled in room.js under MIT licenses,
copied alongside. Spark worker/decoder code is embedded in the local bundle.
